about: PARTICLES layers in Godot (r179, docs/effect-layers.md phase 2). Not a pixel comparison: each engine draws its own particle system. engines/godot/tests/particles.gd scrolls each scene at 60 units/s, stepped at 1/60 s, and checks at 0, 6 and 12 s that the layer's Godot scene is instanced, between the layers before and after it, where its layer has scrolled it; it saves a still of each. Pages and scenes from core/test-data/particles (libGDX's round there). Its q06 to q08 zoom the camera, dollied or not (r278); q09 and q10 are round a planet (r330, r347), each node turned as one block as its box's middle is.

scenes.name: view-anchored-gpu
scenes.about: snow-wide.tscn (a GPUParticles2D) anchored to the VIEW: one instance, carried by the layer's scroll, its emitter kept at the view's top-left

scenes.name: layer-anchored-cpu-repeat-X
scenes.about: snow.tscn (a CPUParticles2D) pinned to the LAYER: an instance at the bottom-left corner of every tile, tiles 30 units apart

scenes.name: layer-anchored-repeat-XY
scenes.about: q02 repeating on X and Y too, scrolling up at 30 units/s: tiles on both axes

scenes.name: cross-fade-tinted
scenes.about: p01 cross-fading into p02 while tinting orange (as libGDX's p03): both pages' particle nodes in their slots, each at its page's opacity; after it, only p02's

scenes.name: no-godot-scene
scenes.about: e06's PARTICLES layer names no Godot scene: nothing instanced, one warning

scenes.name: view-anchored-dollied
scenes.about: q01 dollied in from zoom 1 to 0.6 (r278): the snow at 0.03 against a front of 0.041 is at zoom 0.71 by 12 s, its node placed from the view at zoom 1 and scaled by 1 over that

scenes.name: layer-anchored-dollied-XY
scenes.about: q03 (repeat X and Y, scrolling up) dollied out from 0.8 to 1.3: a node per tile of the layer's own view, wider as it zooms out

scenes.name: layer-anchored-zoomed
scenes.about: q02 zoomed from 1 to 0.7 without the dolly: the nodes placed from the view's corner, every layer at the camera's zoom

scenes.name: layer-anchored-planet
scenes.about: q02 round a planet of 400% (r330, core/test-data/planet/make_round.py): each tile's node turned as one block as its box's middle is, the side ones most (r347)

scenes.name: view-anchored-planet-dollied
scenes.about: q01 round a planet of 400%, dollied in from 1 to 0.7 (r330): the node and its emitter turned as the box's middle from the emitter's place is (r347), in the layer's own view
